name: prd-pr
description: Claude Code dev-workflow plugin. The orchestrator skill drives a 10-phase plan-then-build flow (story -> vertically sliced plan docs with frozen per-slice contracts -> parallel TDD implementation -> one whole-story QA round with independent code and security review, isolated simplify, smoke and regression -> Playwright test-plan walkthrough with screenshots -> PR and backlog close-out), dispatching the code-explorer, code-architect, plan-reviewer, impl-backend, impl-frontend, impl-simplify, code-reviewer, security-reviewer and test-plan-walker subagents plus a companion skill suite. Resumable via a per-story 07-progress.md ledger.
